A [[Gaan's outcasts|group of outcasts]] led by the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gaan]] lived in a '''settlement''' on the the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Confederacy.<ref name="Order of Outcasts">{{CWACite|5|The Order of Outcasts}}</ref> In the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the war,<ref name="Date">"[[The Order of Outcasts]]" takes place during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Joc Sah]] and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Battle of Ragmar V|attacked]] the outcasts in order to use the world as a staging planet for an attack on a [[Unidentified Separatist base (Sev)|Separatist base]].<ref name="Order of Outcasts" />

==Behind the scenes==
The settlement appeared in the short story "[[The Order of Outcasts]]," which was one of four stories compiled in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5|fifth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperbacks]]<ref name="Order of Outcasts" /> published on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/13-402/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Vol-5-TPB|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Vol. 5 TPB}}</ref>
